item: X2 SinoHydro Rudong Intertidal: what is a 低桩高台柱 foundation?
proposal: (lead, no row) Classification: NOT a high-rise pile cap. 低桩高台柱 = a low (buried) pile cap on a ring of piles with a tall concrete pedestal carrying the tower above high water. Options for the owner: (a) add a type, e.g. 'lp': ('低樁承台', 'Low pile cap', 'other'); (b) file it under pc with a note that the cap is buried, not raised; (c) keep the farm in EXCLUDED. Whatever is chosen, the row still needs the 10 shore-side units: when found, F5('CHN', 'SinoHydro Rudong Intertidal', 'mx', parts=[['<lp|pc>', 20], ['jk', 12], ['<type>', 10]], url='https://www.msa.gov.cn/msacncms_wap/pages/content.jhtml?articleId=2c011c1d33c14754a862cf5b3be89312', ...).
note_zh: 「低樁高台柱」：灘塗上先築圍堰、打一圈管樁，樁頂在灘面以下，於基坑內澆築承台（承台埋在泥面下），再以高立柱把塔筒基礎環抬到最高潮位以上。承台不離開海床，與「高樁承台」（承台高於海床、樁有自由段）不同。
note_en: "Low pile, tall pedestal": on the tidal flat a cofferdam is built and a ring of piles driven, the pile heads are cut below the mud surface and the cap is cast in a pit (buried below the mudline), then a tall column lifts the tower flange above the highest tide. The cap does not stand clear of the seabed, unlike a high-rise pile cap whose piles have a free length.
why: No document describes the SinoHydro Rudong foundation itself, but (1) the owner, 中国水电建设集团如东新能源有限公司, patented its tidal-flat turbine platform method (CN107217681A, 2017): drive foundation piles in an array, sheet-pile cofferdam, excavate 6–7 m, tie rebar and pour concrete, solving the large gap between the natural mud level and the platform top; (2) Sinohydro Bureau 4 patented a "tidal-flat wind low pile cap foundation" (CN105926660B, 2016): cofferdam, 30 PHC piles whose heads end 0.8–1.2 m below the mud, cap cast in an excavated pit; (3) a 2009 utility model (CN201390974Y) describes the same concept: buried base slab on rings of piles with a tall column whose top is above the highest tide. Together these define the MSA notice’s 低桩高台柱 as a buried pile cap with a tall pedestal. The patents are not tied to the project by name except through the owner’s assignee, so they define the term rather than prove the as-built design. The 10 shore-side units (probably the 20 MW phase 1, 10 × 2 MW) are still unknown.

item: X3 Longyuan Putian Nanri Island (= Longyuan "Sandun" wind farm): foundation types, depth, turbines
proposal: (lead, no F5 row) D row ready once a foundation row exists: D('CHN', 'Longyuan Putian Nanri Island', depth=(5, 30), url='http://www.chnenergybidding.com.cn/bidweb/001/001002/001002003/20241012/0bb917b6-a698-43e0-a307-3aa587e4bcf3.html', zh='福建龍源 2024-10 三墩風電場（南日島海上一期）航標維護招標：A 區 55 部、理論水深 5–20 m，B 區 45 部、理論水深 10–30 m。', en='Fujian Longyuan navaid maintenance tender (Oct 2024) for the Sandun wind farm (Nanri Island offshore phase 1): area A 55 turbines in 5–20 m (chart datum), area B 45 turbines in 10–30 m.'). Data check for the caller: the farm is 100 × Siemens SWT-4.0-130 (plus one 4 MW floating demo), not Goldwind GW171-6.45 as in the record’s turbine field; the 2022 oil-spill tender says all units were in production by the end of 2021 (record year 2019).
why: CHN Energy full-text search: after completion Longyuan calls the farm 三墩风电场 (Sandun), A + B areas, 100 Siemens 4 MW. Foundation lots found only as tenders: lot VIII (12 units: piling, rock-socketing, pile caps) and lot IX (18 units: drilling, piling and installing the 套笼 cages); lots I–VII predate the platform. The 2022 sea-use post-evaluation, completion environmental acceptance and 2023 turbine-position re-survey tenders, and the 2023–2025 anti-corrosion tenders (one mentions 三墩 turbine foundation pile caps) give no per-type counts.

item: X5 CGN Shanwei Jiazi I and II: foundation counts
farm: CGN Shanwei Jiazi I; CGN Shanwei Jiazi II
why: CGN e-procurement API: Jiazi tenders listed from 2018 to 2026. Original (2019) design for both farms: jacket lot I = 17 non-rock-socketed jackets (15 turbines + 2 substations) and monopile lots I and II (30 positions each); Jiazi II was re-tendered in 2022 for 50 × 8 MW as lots I (20 positions) and II (20 positions) without a stated type and lot III (10 monopiles + substation); the 2021–2022 cathodic-protection tenders cover "monopiles and jackets" for each farm. Post-construction tenders (2022 operating-period navaids, 2025–2026 defect rectification "monopile foundation anti-corrosion") give no counts. So Jiazi I’s 7 non-monopile units (probably jackets) and Jiazi II’s lots I/II types remain unconfirmed as built.
